scripts.dev: npm run build -w @flowsync/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web,worker "npm run dev -w @flowsync/contracts" "npm run dev -w @flowsync/api" "npm run dev -w @flowsync/web" "npm run worker:dev -w @flowsync/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowsync/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @flowsync/api && npm run build -w @flowsync/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flowsync/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @flowsync/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run test -w @flowsync/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @flowsync/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run test:e2e -w @flowsync/api
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init mailpit
